images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT IMAGE 1, the supplied finished burning-forest parallax canvas. IMAGE 2 is only a supporting reference for hand-painted ink and watercolor technique, never its content or overall pale palette. Deliver exactly one 1536x1024 image with the identical framing and composition of IMAGE 1. Change ONLY digital-glitch artifacts within the existing fire: repaint blocky rectangular flame-tip fragments, sideways displaced horizontal fire slices, horizontal tear/scan lines, stair-stepped flame contours, and cyan/magenta fringes as ordinary hand-painted flames in precisely the same places. Use soft licking orange-gold tongues with darker red edges, organic ragged tapered contours, and small round ember dots. Preserve the exact extent, size, front edge and distribution of all burning areas; do not enlarge, shrink, relocate or remove fire. Keep EVERYTHING ELSE exactly as in IMAGE 1: every standing tree, fallen trunk, smoke curl, rock, scorched ground detail, river contour and reflection, hills, colors, linework, texture, contrast and framing. Preserve any existing pure #00ff00 background exactly; do not introduce a green area where none exists in this crop. Do not restyle, recolor, sharpen or move anything. The replacement fire must match the existing crisp dark sepia-to-near-black wavering pen contour and hand-laid watercolor washes, with uneven pooling, granulation and softly blooming pigment. Maintain the manuscript-derived stylized landscape and elevated three-quarter orthographic view, the existing warm sunset lighting and violet smoke, and the hand-painted 1990s tactical role-playing illustration rendering. No new glow effects, rim lighting, lens effects, digital gradients or filled dark shadows. No text, figures, buildings, border or vignette. This is a minimal local repair of the fire only, not a repaint of the landscape.

concerns: The supplied canvas contains no visible #00ff00 region above a treeline; none was added.
Visual inspection shows organic flames and preserved landscape composition; pixel-exact preservation outside the fire was not verified.
